suttas.title: Bhikkhunupassayasutta
rows: Atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṁ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena aññataro bhikkhunupassayo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yenaññataro bhikkhunūpassayo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
Atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena aññataro bhikkhunupassayo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sāvatthiyaṃ. bhagavā. atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena aññataro bhikkhunūpassayo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
Atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena aññataro bhikkhunupassayo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
Atha kho āyasmā Ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena aññataro bhikkhunupassayo tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi || || 2.
Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhuniyo yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṁ ānandaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdiṁsu. Ekamantaṁ nisinnā kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmantaṁ ānandaṁ etadavocuṁ:
atha kho sambahulā bhikkhuniyo yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ:

Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhuniyo yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ –
atha kho sambahulā bhikkhuniyo yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ
Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhuniyo yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ—

Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhuniyo yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Ānandam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmantam Ānandam etad avocuṃ || || 3.
“Idha, bhante ānanda, sambahulā bhikkhuniyo catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacittā viharantiyo uḷāraṁ pubbenāparaṁ visesaṁ sañjānantī”ti.

rows: Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
atha kho āyasmā sārīputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sārīputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca—
Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto yena Bhagavā tenupa saṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā || pe || Ekam antam nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3.

suttas.title: Bāhiyasutta

atha kho āyasmā bāhiyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā bāhiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:

atha kho āyasmā bāhiyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā bāhiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

Atha kho āyasmā Bāhiyo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā || [pe] || ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Bāhiyo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
“sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṁ desetu, yamahaṁ bhagavato dhammaṁ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyan”ti.

Idha tvaṁ, bhikkhu, pātimokkhasaṁvarasaṁvuto viharāhi ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhassu sikkhāpadesu.
idha tvaṃ bhikkhu, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharāhi ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhasi sikkhāpadesu.

idha tvaṃ bhikkhu pāṭimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharāhi ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhassu sikkhāpadesu.
Idha tvaṃ, bhikkhu, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharāhi ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhassu sikkhāpadesu.

rows: cattāro me bhikkhave oghā. katame cattāro: kāmogho, bhavogho, diṭṭhogho, avijjogho. ime kho bhikkhave, cattāro oghā. imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, catunnaṃ oghānaṃ abhiññāya cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā. katame cattāro: …pe… bhāvetabboti. 3. 10. 160. uddhambhāgiyasuttaṃ pañcimāni bhikkhave, uddhambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṁ uddhambhāgiyānaṁ saṁyojanānaṁ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā.
imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā.
Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā.
imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā.

ms.sn47.95-104:4.4: vitthāretuvaggo → This mention as well as the Uddāna is to be found in S1-3 only, but put before the last text of the vaggo (uddambhāgiyāni). (pts note) | vitthāretabbaṁ → This summing up mention is in B1-2 only instead of the mention of the chapters V11-X. (pts note) | samattaṁ → This word added in S1-3 only. To be noticed. The sixth text of this Saṁyutta (the sakuṇagghī pages 146-147) occurs frequently. See particularly Milinda (pāli) p. 365;-- Julien's avadānas N.99--Lane's arabian nights.2.58. (pts note) | Sāvatthi → B2 adds yam. (pts note)
